problem: The CLI runner must be able to pull unprocessed comments since a marker (`hlx comments list --since` or equivalent) so the host agent can transition from push-based to pull-based comment delivery. The `--since` flag already exists in the CLI but filtering is client-side only — server-side support and/or the pull integration with the runner need to be verified and potentially enhanced.

files.why: Implements `hlx comments list` with `--since` flag (L18, L30-34). Currently fetches all comments via GET /tickets/{ticketId}/comments and filters client-side by createdAt. Core file for pull-based comment retrieval.
Implements `hlx comments post`. Used by runner to post replies back. Relevant for understanding the full runner comment lifecycle.
Command routing for comments subcommand. Registers list and post handlers.
hxFetch() function (L37-134) — HTTP client with retry logic, auth headers, 30s timeout. Used by comments list/post. basePath '/api' used for comment endpoints.
getFlag() utility used to parse --since flag value from args.
HxConfig type definition — API key and URL configuration for CLI.
Build: tsc. Test: tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js. Typecheck: tsc --noEmit. No ORM or database dependencies.

facts: `hlx comments list --since <iso-date>` already exists (src/comments/list.ts:18,30-34). The --since flag is parsed via getFlag() and filters comments where createdAt > sinceDate.
Filtering is entirely client-side: all comments are fetched via GET /tickets/{ticketId}/comments, then filtered in JavaScript. No query parameter is sent to the server.
`hlx comments post --ticket <ref> <message>` posts to POST /tickets/{ticketId}/comments with body { content: message }.
The CLI has no runner or host-agent code. It is a stateless API client. The 'runner' in the ticket context refers to code running inside the sprite that calls `hlx` commands.
No dedicated test files exist for comments commands. Test framework: Node.js built-in test module.
No ORM or database dependencies. CLI communicates via HTTP to helix-global-server.
Auth: hxFetch sends X-API-Key header for hxi_ tokens, Bearer token otherwise. The runner on the sprite has HELIX_API_KEY set via /app/.helix-env.
No CLAUDE.md or README.md at repo root. Command reference at skill-content/references/commands.md.
Comment response type includes: id, author (name, email), content, isHelixTagged, isAgentAuthored, createdAt.
Build scripts: build='tsc', typecheck='tsc --noEmit', test='tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js', prepare='npm run build'.
unknowns: Whether client-side --since filtering is sufficient for the runner pull use case, or if a server-side query parameter is needed for scalability (large comment histories).
Whether the runner needs to output comments in a machine-parseable format (JSON) for programmatic pull consumption, vs the current human-readable text output.
Whether additional flags are needed (e.g., --json output, --after-id for cursor-based pagination by comment ID rather than timestamp).
Whether comment ordering guarantees (createdAt ascending) are sufficient for the runner's idempotent processing, or if comment ID ordering is needed.
